script: Test whether the quarterly privileged-access review of LearnTech's Amsterdam office operated as BKB-POL-006 requires, in each quarter of the test period.

The review records of LearnTech's four review quarters: Q1 October–December 2025, Q2 January–March 2026, Q3 April–June 2026, Q4 July–September 2026. One record per privileged account per quarter: 48 records (dataset CT-DATA).
The quarters to test: rule R15 by the control's frequency, selected by the platform with the seed. Every record of a sampled quarter is tested.
The record has a review date and a decision, Keep or Revoke.
The review date is no later than 15 days after the end of the record's quarter.
Session recording is On where the account's system is Mission Critical (BKB-POL-006 Section 4, LOW).
The reviewer is not the privileged account's holder (BKB-POL-006 Section 6.2 step 2).
Where the decision is Revoke, Revocation executed has a date.
A record passes when it passes A1 to A6; a record that fails any of them is a deviation, rated with rule R26. The test concludes with rule R19.
checks: Reviewed: the record has a review date and a decision, Keep or Revoke.
On time: the review date is no later than 15 days after the end of the record's quarter.
Session recording: session recording is On where the account's system is Mission Critical (BKB-POL-006 Section 4, LOW).
Independent reviewer: the reviewer is not the privileged account's holder (BKB-POL-006 Section 6.2 step 2).
Revocation executed: where the decision is Revoke, Revocation executed has a date.
reqs: BKB-POL-006 Section 3.1: Multi-factor authentication is required for remote, privileged and Tier 3/4 access
BKB-POL-006 Section 3.1: Privileged access is held in a privileged-access management (PAM) tool, granted just in time
BKB-POL-006 Section 4 (LOW): Privileged access review — Quarterly
BKB-POL-006 Section 4 (LOW): Session recording for privileged access — Mission Critical systems
BKB-POL-006 Section 6.2 step 2: Confirm or reject each account; the reviewer is never the account holder
BKB-POL-006 Section 6.2 step 3: Remove every rejected account or role (≤ 5 working days)
iam: The IAM team's answer to your query on PR-022: “The Q2 review of adm-petrov11 waited for its system owner, who was on leave until 27 April 2026. Section 6.2 names no deputy reviewer, and nothing in the PAM tool reminds anyone when a quarter's review is due or overdue.”
facts: BKB-POL-006 Section 6.2 step 2: the asset owner confirms or rejects each account, each quarter for privileged access (Section 4).
PR-022: the Q2 review of adm-petrov11 was done on 2026-04-29, 29 days after the quarter ended; the script allows 15 (A2).
Section 6.2 must name a deputy reviewer for each system and escalate any review not done 15 days after its quarter ends.
The procedure names no deputy reviewer, and nothing reminds the reviewer or escalates when a review is overdue.
The system owner did not take the deadline seriously.
The system owner who reviews adm-petrov11 was on leave until 27 April 2026, and the review waited for their return.
actions: Correct the instance (Ref-Actions CT): PR-022's Q2 review is on record as completed late, on 2026-04-29, with the reason.

Add the missing step to the procedure and train the owners (L18): a deputy reviewer for each system and an escalation of any review not done 15 days after its quarter ends, in BKB-POL-006 Section 6.2.
Re-test 3 months later (L18): the next quarter's privileged-access review, with this test script.
